subject: Your dog's secret 2AM snack time
preview_text: One user's surprise discovery about the app's hidden feature that changed their dog's health.
body_paragraphs: Last week, a user emailed me with a confession: they'd been using PupShape to plan their dog's midnight treat runs. I never expected anyone to use the app this way, but it makes perfect sense. Their dog was waking them up at 2AM, begging for a bite—and they'd grab whatever was closest. Not anymore.

Here's the twist: they set up a custom 'midnight snack' in the calorie calculator. A single dental chew, a few blueberries, or a sliver of boiled chicken—all within the daily limit. The dog still gets the ritual, but now it's guilt-free. Their vet noticed a 3% weight drop in two weeks, and the dog sleeps better, too.

This is exactly why we built the treat logging feature. It's not just for meals—it's for every single bite, no matter the hour. Open the app, tap 'Add a Treat,' and you'll see exactly how it fits into your dog's plan. Surprise yourself with what's possible.

So tonight, when your pup gives you those big eyes at 2AM, open PupShape first. Log it, love it, and keep them healthy. P.S. One user logged 47 treats in a week and still hit their weight goal—proof that flexibility wins.
